This is the 1st episode of our Madhya Pradesh series, Total we have made 5 episodes of Madhya Pradesh. In this video we have covered the heritage place, Indori street food and more.
We are buying spices from place of origins and making these available for you in smaller quantities.you can check out our website here.

Date of Journey - 29th July 2026
We started our day from Gandhi Hall which is called Town Hall, Famous for its majestic 90 foot tall four-faced clock tower.
